name: Longipteryx
sum: Long-snouted, long-winged enantiornithean from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning with hooked teeth at the snout tip.
wsnote: Holotype wingspan about 46.3 cm and body mass about 193 g (Wikipedia revision cited); length not given.
holotype: A skeleton from the Jiufotang Formation at Chaoyang, Liaoning (number in Zhang et al. 2000).
material: The holotype and several referred specimens.
biology: A long snout with a few hooked teeth at the tip and long strong wings; first read as a fish- or insect-eater, it has more recently been argued to have eaten fruit (2024 study cited in the Wikipedia revision).
author: Zhang et al. 2000
